name: export-book
description: Renders a book's chapters (title + author + markdown body per chapter) into a KDP-style .docx or a valid EPUB2 .epub file, written zero-dependency from scratch (hand-built OOXML/EPUB XML plus a hand-rolled ZIP container) — no pandoc, no network. Supports the minimal markdown the source pipeline uses: paragraphs separated by blank lines, *italic*/_italic_ and **bold** inline runs, and scene breaks ('---', '***', '* * *', or '⁂' alone on a line). Call this last, once chapter markdown is finalized, to produce the deliverable file. WARNING: an existing file at 'out' is overwritten silently, with no confirmation step — check the returned 'overwrote' field if that matters to the caller.

language.description: IETF (BCP 47) language tag, e.g. 'en' or 'pt-BR', for the EPUB metadata and every XHTML page's xml:lang. Defaults to 'en'; ignored for docx. Anything not shaped like a language tag is rejected.

out.description: Output path, relative to the working directory. Refused if absolute or if it resolves outside the working directory.

overwrote.description: True if a file already existed at 'out' and was overwritten. This tool always overwrites silently; check this field if that matters to the caller.
